import struct,zlib
d=open('spec.png','rb').read()
p=8;idat=b''
while p<len(d):
    n,t=struct.unpack('>I4s',d[p:p+8]);c=d[p+8:p+8+n]
    if t==b'IDAT':idat+=c
    p+=12+n
r=zlib.decompress(idat);W,H,bpp=244,32,3;st=W*bpp
prev=bytearray(st);i=0;rows=[]

        elif f==4:
            pa=abs(b-c);pb=abs(a-c);pc=abs(a+b-2*c)
            pr=a if pa<=pb and pa<=pc else (b if pb<=pc else c)
            line[x]=(line[x]+pr)&255
    rows.append(line);prev=line
for y in range(2,30,2):
    print(''.join('#' if rows[y][x*3]<128 else '.' for x in range(140,244,2)))
